title: Vehicle Purchase Agreements Deposit Schedule by Deal Type
content:
**Deposit schedule for the Vehicle Purchase Agreements.** This schedule sets, for each deal type, how much deposit money the store accepts and holds, how it may be paid, and what happens to it when a deal does not go ahead.

## Amounts and payment methods

| Deal type | Smallest reservation deposit (USD) | Largest total deposit held before contract (USD) | Payment methods accepted for a deposit | Largest part of the deposits payable by credit card (USD) | Largest total paid by credit card on the deal, deposits and payments together (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Value Line Used Vehicle Purchase | 250.00 | 2500.00 | cash, cashier's check, debit card, credit card | 2500.00 | 3000.00 |
| Used Vehicle Retail Purchase | 500.00 | 5000.00 | cash, check, cashier's check, debit card, credit card, ACH | 3000.00 | 5000.00 |
| Certified Pre-Owned Vehicle Purchase | 500.00 | 5000.00 | cash, check, cashier's check, debit card, credit card, ACH | 3000.00 | 5000.00 |
| New Vehicle Retail Purchase | 1000.00 | 10000.00 | cash, check, cashier's check, debit card, credit card, ACH | 5000.00 | 7500.00 |
| New Vehicle Factory Order Purchase | 1500.00 | 10000.00 | cash, check, cashier's check, debit card, credit card, ACH | 5000.00 | 7500.00 |
| Fleet Vehicle Purchase Agreement | 2500.00 | 25000.00 | check, cashier's check, ACH | 0.00 | 0.00 |

A credit card figure of 0.00 means no deposit or payment on that deal type may be made by credit card.

## Refunds and non-refundable portion

| Deal type | Non-refundable portion once the reservation is placed (USD) | Refund issued within (calendar days after the cancellation, release or unwind) | Non-refundable portion kept when the hold lapses without a contract |
|---|---|---|---|
| Value Line Used Vehicle Purchase | 0.00 | 10 | no |
| Used Vehicle Retail Purchase | 0.00 | 10 | no |
| Certified Pre-Owned Vehicle Purchase | 0.00 | 10 | no |
| New Vehicle Retail Purchase | 0.00 | 10 | no |
| New Vehicle Factory Order Purchase | 500.00 | 10 | yes |
| Fleet Vehicle Purchase Agreement | 0.00 | 15 | no |

A non-refundable portion of 0.00 means the deposit is fully refundable. On a New Vehicle Factory Order Purchase the portion becomes non-refundable once the reservation is placed, that is, once the order is transmitted to the factory.

## Points of the schedule
- **Hypothetical.** A first deposit of 900.00 on a New Vehicle Retail Purchase is below that deal type's smallest reservation deposit of 1000.00. On a Used Vehicle Retail Purchase the same 900.00 is above the 500.00 minimum.
- The credit card columns measure two different things. The first caps the credit card part of the deposits. The second caps all credit card money on the deal, deposits and payments together.
